world.resource.carryingCapacity.label: Carrying capacity
world.resource.carryingCapacity.help: How many people the land can support — the aggregate of all resources.
world.resource.arable.label: Arable land
world.resource.arable.help: Soil and climate suitable for growing crops.
world.resource.fish.label: Fish
world.resource.fish.help: Marine catch, richest over cool upwelling and shelf waters.
world.resource.game.label: Game / forage
world.resource.game.help: Wild animals to hunt and plants to gather.
world.resource.pasture.label: Pasture
world.resource.timber.label: Timber
world.resource.timber.help: Usable wood — high in forests, scarce in open or cold land.
world.resource.salt.label: Salt
world.resource.salt.help: Evaporite salt, strongest on warm dry coasts and arid basins.
world.resource.toolStone.label: Tool-stone
world.resource.copper.label: Copper
world.resource.copper.help: Copper ore, tied to the geology of arcs and sutures.
world.resource.tin.label: Tin
world.resource.tin.help: Tin ore from collision belts — scarce and prized for bronze.
world.resource.iron.label: Iron
world.resource.iron.help: Iron ore, the most widespread of the metals.
world.resource.gold.label: Gold
world.resource.gold.help: Gold, concentrated near volcanic arcs and old cratons.
world.resource.silver.label: Silver
world.resource.silver.help: Silver from hydrothermal deposits near volcanic arcs.
world.resource.gems.label: Gems
world.resource.gems.help: Gemstones from metamorphic belts and arid gravels.
world.species.human.label: Humans
world.species.human.help: Toggle the humans and place their point of origin.
world.species.dwarf.label: Dwarves
world.species.dwarf.help: Toggle the dwarves and place their point of origin.
world.species.beaver.label: Beavers
world.species.beaver.help: Toggle the beavers and place their point of origin.
world.overlay.terrain.label: Terrain colour
world.overlay.terrain.help: Colour the map by its natural relief and land cover.
world.overlay.group.genesis.label: Genesis
world.overlay.group.genesis.help: Mantle field, craton age, volcanoes and hotspot plumes.
world.overlay.group.tectonics.label: Tectonics
world.overlay.group.climate.label: Climate
world.overlay.group.climate.help: Temperature, seasonality, wind, currents, rainfall, monsoon and biomes.
world.overlay.boundaries.label: Voronoi cells
world.overlay.boundaries.help: Outline the tectonic plates. In Genesis it previews the plates a hand-off would produce.
world.overlay.names.label: Continent names
world.overlay.names.help: Label the continents once tectonics has begun.
world.overlay.mantle.label: Mantle field
world.overlay.mantle.help: Show where the mantle rises and sinks beneath the crust.
world.overlay.mantle.legend.title: Mantle field
world.overlay.volcanoes.label: Volcanoes
world.overlay.volcanoes.help: Mark the volcanoes the plates have built — hotspot chains, island arcs, flood basalts.
world.overlay.volcanoes.legend.title: Volcanoes
world.overlay.hotspots.label: Hotspot plumes
world.overlay.hotspots.help: Mark the deep-mantle plumes themselves — the fixed sources the volcano chains trail from.
world.overlay.hotspots.legend.title: Hotspot plumes
world.overlay.cratonAge.label: Craton age
world.overlay.cratonAge.help: Colour the crust by age — pale where it just formed, deep where it is as old as the world.
world.overlay.temperature.label: Temperature
world.overlay.temperature.help: Colour the map by mean annual air temperature.
world.overlay.seasonality.label: Seasonality
world.overlay.seasonality.help: Show how far temperature swings between seasons.
world.overlay.wind.label: Wind
world.overlay.currents.label: Ocean currents
world.overlay.currents.help: Show the wind-driven ocean gyres and their warm/cold flow.
world.overlay.precipitation.label: Precipitation
world.overlay.precipitation.help: Colour the map by annual rainfall.
world.overlay.monsoon.label: Monsoon / precip seasonality
world.overlay.monsoon.help: Show how strongly rainfall concentrates into a wet season.
world.overlay.monsoon.legend.title: Monsoon index
world.overlay.biomes.label: Biomes
world.overlay.biomes.help: Classify the land into biomes from temperature and rainfall.
world.overlay.rivers.label: Rivers & lakes
world.overlay.rivers.help: Draw the river network and standing lakes.
world.overlay.waterBalance.label: Water balance
world.overlay.waterBalance.help: Rainfall minus evaporation — where the land gains water and where it loses it.
world.overlay.watersheds.label: Watersheds
world.overlay.watersheds.help: Each river system's catchment in its own colour.
world.overlay.group.hydrology.label: Hydrology
world.overlay.group.hydrology.help: Rivers and lakes, water balance and watersheds.
world.overlay.resources.label: Ecology (resources)
world.overlay.resources.help: Colour the map by the selected resource's abundance.
world.overlay.migration.label: Migration
world.overlay.migration.help: Show where each species spreads from its origin.
world.overlay.migration.legend.title: Peoples
